verdict.rationale: Open WebUI has its own versioning discipline: a Keep-a-Changelog changelog, a stated SemVer commitment, and per-version plugin-API migration guides for breaking releases. However, the REST API reference is declared experimental, no REST deprecation window is promised, and the :main tag can ship breaking changes without warning. That falls well short of a reliable versioned API with a documented deprecation policy. Missing for 10: explicitly versioned REST endpoints, a documented REST deprecation policy and timeline, a stable (non-experimental) API contract, and independent corroboration of API stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
